constant_columns.treatment_protocol_ch1: To induce skeletal muscle-specific LSD1 knockout, 20 mg/mL tamoxifen in corn oil was administered intraperitoneally to eight-week-old male LSD1-mKO or WT mice at a dose of 75 mg/kg for five consecutive days. From the fourth day of tamoxifen administration, dexamethasone at 1 mg/kg was intraperitoneally administered for seven consecutive days.
constant_columns.growth_protocol_ch1: Mice were maintained in a temperature-controlled animal facility with a 12-h light/12-h dark cycle and fed ad libitum on a regular diet. All procedures were conducted in accordance with the guidelines of the Animal Care and Use Committee of Kumamoto University.
constant_columns.extract_protocol_ch1: Total RNA from the muscles were extracted using a Trizol reagent (Invitrogen). mRNA was purified using NEBNext Poly(A) mRNA Magnetic Isolation Module (NEB).,cDNA library for sequencing was synthesized using NEB Next Ultra DNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina (NEB) and was sequenced on NextSeq 500 sequencer (Illumina) with 75-bps single-end reads.
constant_columns.data_processing: Resulting reads were aligned to the UCSC mm10 reference genome by using STAR.,Edge R was used for quantification of gene expression changes, in which an FDR cut-off of 0.05 was used to determine differentially expressed genes between WT and KO mice.,Assembly: mm10,Supplementary files format and content: all_genes_FC_Gas.txt and all_genes_FC_Sol.txt in text file format.
